sloka: अयोध्याधिपतिस्तस्य श्रुत्वा पापात्मनो वचः ।अनरण्यस्तु सङ्क्रुद्धो राक्षसेन्द्रमथाब्रवीत् ।। ७.१९.९ ॥
transliteration: ayodhyādhipatistasya śrutvā pāpātmano vacaḥ ।anaraṇyastu saṅkruddho rākṣasendramathābravīt ।। 7.19.9 ॥

translations.english: Having approached the king, Ravana said, "Give me battle, or else declare 'I am conquered' – this is my command to you."
